questions.comprehension_passage: PROBLEM DECOMPOSITION The figure shows an AND-OR decomposition of problem S into smaller problems. The nodes are uniquely identified by labels (S, A, B, C, …). Each node shows the heuristic estimate of the cost of solving that node. Nodes shown in double lines are primitive nodes and their values are actual costs. A primitive node is added to the graph, with SOLVED status, when its parent is expanded. And therefore, a primitive node is never expanded. The cost of each edge is 2 units. Tie-breaker 1: If several nodes have the same cost then break the tie using node labels. Tie-breaker 2: For AND nodes, select the unsolved branch with the highest cost. [IMAGE: /data/images/cs3003_2025T3_ET_FN_p8_Im1.webp|block] Use AO* algorithm to solve S, then answer the sub-questions.
